prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
I can help pick the best place — but “best” depends on your dates, budget and priorities. A few quick questions before I search specific listings:

- When are you traveling and how many nights?  
- Budget per night (or total)?  
- Kids’ ages? (helps with sleeping arrangements and gear needs)  
- Prefer walkable/fun neighborhoods (12South, The Gulch, Germantown) or quieter/suburban (Green Hills, Franklin, Bellevue)?  
- Must-haves (parking, crib, fenced yard, washer/dryer, bathtub, pool, elevator, pet-friendly)?

Meanwhile, here are targeted recommendations and tips so you know what to look for:

Neighborhoods that work well for a family of four
- Germantown — family-friendly, walkable to restaurants and riverfront parks; close to downtown (5–10 min drive). Good mix of condos and renovated houses.  
- 12 South — very walkable, lots of kid-friendly restaurants and shops; small houses and duplexes. Good for daytime strolling.  
- East Nashville (near Five Points) — artsy, laid-back, many single-family homes with yards; parks and kid activities nearby.  
- The Gulch/Downtown — best if you want to be in the middle of attractions; mostly condos/townhomes but can be noisy at night.  
- Green Hills / Belle Meade — quieter, more suburban, great if you want a yard and short drive to malls/parks; ~15–20 min from downtown.  
- Franklin (20–30 min south) — historic town feel, great if you want a quieter getaway with lots of family-friendly rentals.

What type of rental to pick
- 2-bedroom entire home or townhouse (so kids can have their own room).  
- If kids are small, a 1–2 bedroom place with a sleeper sofa plus a host-provided Pack ’n Play can work.  
- Look for a ground-floor apartment or a house with a fenced yard if you want outdoor space.

Must-have filters and features to search for
- Entire home/apt, at least 2 beds, recent positive reviews (4.8+), Superhost/Top-Rated Host if possible.  
- Free/secure parking (important in many Nashville neighborhoods).  
- Kitchen, washer/dryer, air conditioning (Nashville summers are hot), reliable Wi‑Fi.  
- Kid gear: Pack ’n Play, high chair, bathtub or baby tub listed.  
- Safety: smoke/CO detectors, gated/fenced yard if needed.  
- Flexible cancellation if travel plans might change.

Booking and safety tips
- Read the last 6–12 months of reviews (cleanliness, noise, host responsiveness).  
- Confirm exact sleeping arrangements in messages (mattress sizes, common areas).  
- Ask host about noise at night if near Broadway/Gulch.  
- Check check-in logistics (self-check-in keypad is helpful with kids).  
- If driving, confirm parking is included and where to park.

If you want, I can pull specific current Airbnb/VRBO options for your dates and budget — tell me the details above and I’ll shortlist 4–6 family-friendly listings (with pros/cons for each). Which dates and budget should I use?
